stats: 33 STORIES · 12 COUNTRIES · ALL FROM WEDNESDAY 18 NOVEMBER 2026

heroes.headline: Trump and Putin shake hands as Xi opens APEC in Shenzhen
heroes.body: The US and Russian presidents meet in person for the first time since 2025; Xi defends free trade and warns against 'unilateralism' as a historic three-way summit is set for Thursday.

heroes.headline: US defence chief in surprise Caracas visit signs military cooperation deal
heroes.body: Pete Hegseth meets acting President Delcy Rodríguez in Caracas; the agreement targets threats from 'foreign actors', ahead of a planned stop in Colombia on security cooperation.

heroes.headline: Russia hammers Odesa city centre; Ukraine says drones hit two oil refineries
heroes.body: Three morning strikes on central Odesa kill 4 and injure 9, the regional governor says; Kyiv's General Staff confirms overnight hits on the Ilsky and Afip refineries in Krasnodar Krai.

cards.headline: US loses measles-free status
cards.body: 5,400 cases and 12 deaths across 31 states; CDC warns importation risk from Europe surge as national MMR rates slip to 91%.

cards.headline: Nvidia Q3 revenue $115.8bn
cards.body: Beats by $4.2bn on Blackwell demand; data-center sales double YoY but China H20 export curbs weigh on Q4 guidance.

cards.headline: Democrat Peltola wins Alaska Senate race
cards.body: Mary Peltola flips the seat, leaving two midterm races still uncalled nearly two weeks after election day.

cards.headline: GTA VI launch hit by glitches
cards.body: Rockstar's 13-years-in-the-making sequel crashes on consoles at launch; servers buckle under record demand.

cards.headline: Apple iCloud, Pay and App Store outage
cards.body: Services wobble for hours on the day of a nationwide FEMA alert test; several bank apps report failures too.

cards.headline: Mexico halts Christie's auction of a Frida Kahlo
cards.body: The government asks the auction house to clarify provenance of 'Congress of Peoples for Peace', believed to have left Mexico in 1952.
